items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: You know, I guess Willie Parker's about the oldest musician living.

ctx.x: Next column. Yeah. Sign the contract for next year right now. As soon as you get on playing that job. You got the next job.

You know, I guess Willie Parker's about the oldest musician living. You know him? Remember him? He's a bass drum player and clarinet player? Who they? Willie Parker. He's still alive. Boy, he's an old man. He played with the Lions Brass Band. The Terminal Brass Band. He's doing some bands. I don't know. You didn't know that? I don't know. I can't.
